title: StepUp: Fitness Tracker Coach
context: Smartwatches record steps and heart rate every minute. A coaching app finds streaks, best weeks and fair goals.
input: Daily steps array; per-minute heart-rate array; workout durations.

milestones.title: Favourite activity
milestones.requirement: Count sessions per activity type (count array); report the most frequent.

milestones.title: Exactly 60 minutes
milestones.requirement: Count ways to pick workouts (each at most once) totalling exactly 60 minutes (backtracking).

milestones.title: Best 7-day week
milestones.requirement: Highest total over any 7 consecutive days (fixed window).

milestones.title: A fair daily goal
milestones.requirement: Largest daily goal met on at least 5 of 7 days (binary search on the goal).

milestones.title: Peak heart rate
milestones.requirement: Rolling maximum heart rate over 3-minute windows (monotonic deque).
